paper_level_summary_zh: 引用论文在相关工作部分将目标论文列为基于RFID的声学窃听方法，指出其需要预装RFID标签，实用性较低，未涉及亚毫米级精度或具体能力认可。

evidences.evidence_quote: [23] utilizes RFID tags and cGAN to perform acoustic eavesdropping, but this approach is less practical as it requires pre-installing RFID tags near the target.
evidences.evidence_context: In Wireless-Based Acoustic Eavesdropping section: '...Overall, these methods based on WiFi signals and impulse radio [14], [15], [21], [22], [23] are limited by the inadequate vibration resolution caused by low packet rates and long wavelengths. Moreover, they require larger antenna configurations than portable mmWave radars, resulting in a more visible presence of the attacker.'
evidences.reference_entry: C. Wang et al., “Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via RFID by capturing sub-mm level vibration,” in Proc. ACM Interactive Mobile Wearable Ubiquitous Technol., vol. 5, no. 4, pp. 1–25, 2021.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用论文在正文中提及[23]（目标论文）时，仅描述其使用RFID标签和cGAN进行窃听，但指出其需要预装标签、实用性低，且将[23]归入振动分辨率不足的方法，未认可其亚毫米级能力或通过墙窃听能力。因此该引用为负面评价或普通相关工作，不符合submm_precision_claim或capability_recognition模板的积极认定标准。
